prelaunch_updates.text: Teaser: 'The internet finally has a court date. THE DAY is set. Stay close.' The date itself is not disclosed yet (likely mainnet or TGE, unconfirmed). No official GEN contract yet: any GEN token on sale is a scam.

Teaser: 'Something very big is almost here. Stay close.' (thanks quest and wallet-link participants). The DAT public sale on Uniswap CCA is still undated; any DAT token before an official contract is a scam.

Arthur Hayes: 'Come and use the free compute and qualify for mainnet FLOP.' The official testnet page still says the opening is unscored, with voucher earning off and no start block announced, so treat it as unconfirmed. Any FLOP token is a scam.

Pre-Mainnet Staking article (Iván Raskovsky, Chief Ecosystem Officer): Clarke is the mainnet release candidate and mainnet arrives 'soon after' (no date). 1,543 validator seats; about a third go to early contributors backed by Foundation delegation for 1 year. When the program goes live (undated), staking GEN earns 1 Staking Point per GEN per day; 42k GEN per seat, smaller holders enter a lottery; unclaimed community airdrop GEN joins automatically; seats need 30 days of Clarke nodes. Snapshot just before mainnet. No official GEN contract yet: any GEN token on sale is a scam.

Testnet miner onboarding is open (GPU with 16 GB+ VRAM; 50+ miners online). The testnet page still says unscored, with voucher earning disabled and no start block announced, so nothing counts toward the airdrop yet. Any FLOP token is a scam.

Arthur Hayes (Thu 11/26 12:35 AM CT): more agents will be allowed to call the testnet faucet 'once we open up mining and validation in the next few hours'. Official day 3 update: runtime upgraded (2-of-3 founder multisig), public testnet gateway, offline QR wallet setup. flop.finance/testnet still says 'unscored opening' with voucher earning disabled; no voucher start block announced, so nothing counts toward the airdrop yet. Any FLOP token is a scam.

GenLayer thread: each Intelligent Contract sends its developer 10% of the protocol fees it generates, in GEN, tied to a transferable Developer NFT; up to 10% of new issuance reserved for developers, unused part burned. Restates the existing tokenomics paper (no new TGE date). X Live Thu 11/26 10 AM CT on Clarke, the last testnet before mainnet.

GenLayer (official X, Wed 11/25): Clarke is 'the last testnet before mainnet'. X Live Thu 11/26 at 10:00 AM CT (16:00 UTC) with Chief Ecosystem Officer @raskovsky and @AnaRegen on what's next for validators and where Pre-Mainnet Staking comes in. No mainnet or TGE date yet. Any GEN token before an official contract is a scam.

Flop testnet day 2 (official Tue 11/24 9:30 PM CT): six founding validators finalize ~1 block/s; validator registration open for the first 50 seats (two-week grace period); FLOPScan unreliable; miner and agent work counts only from a voucher start block still to be announced; nothing carries over from Devnet; test FLOP has no value. faucet.flop.network now reports a testnet faucet as open (web check Wed 11/25 ~8:10 AM CT; agent grant 10 test FLOP per 24 h). Still unscored. Any FLOP token is a scam.

GenLayer GitHub: Bradbury testnet Phase 3 deployed Tue 11/24 (chain 4221, node v0.6.0) and an epoch-zero validator bootstrap guide published Wed 11/25. Development signal only: still no dated launch day, audit or official contract. Mission GEN in the Court closes Thu 11/26 6:00 AM CT.
